scoring_justification: MAE cannot be recomputed because the checker does not possess the agent's generated morphology dataset and labels; feature importance ranking is checked structurally.

outputs.description: The regression result is scored by checking that the reported test MAE meets a hidden reference threshold (lower is better) and that the feature importance ranking corresponds to the expected order of importance.

output_contract.notes: The workflow must re‑derive the complete pipeline; no pre‑made morphological dataset or pre‑trained model is provided. The random forest hyperparameters and exact implementation are the agent's choice. The checker verifies only the final regression_results.json.

steps.title: MAE threshold check
steps.description: Reported test MAE must be ≤ 0.03 D₀ (the paper's reported threshold). Full credit for ≤0.03; partial credit decays for higher values.

steps.title: Feature importance ranking
steps.description: The two most important features must be v (pore volume) and h (integrated mean curvature).
